messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She begins facing forward, then raises both arms and performs a large, fast spinning motion that blurs her body, before settling back to face the camera.","camera":"Static medium close-up at eye level, centered on the character.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top with dark purple straps at the shoulders.","hair_color":"Bright yellow-blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky blonde hair that stands up around her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin and a slender build.","scene":"An outdoor dock or shipyard area with weathered wooden planks, stacked lumber, an overturned wooden boat, and stone buildings in the background under bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's face and skin tone became noticeably darker and more closely aligned with the reference person. The original yellow-blonde spiky hairstyle, pink outfit, dock scene, camera framing, and spinning action were preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person in the video with the reference person, matching facial features and adjusting body skin tone, while preserving the original hairstyle, hair color, expression, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Exact facial-feature match to the reference photo is difficult to verify from the video frames, especially during the fast spinning motion.
